tools.name: bounceban_account
tools.description: Read verification credit balance and account rate limits without starting verification. Limits and credit balance are shared across the account's API keys.

tools.name: bounceban_verify_email
tools.description: Verify one email in regular mode. Costs verification credits on each request, including repeats, and requires confirm:true. Uses the standard API's 15-second result window; returns a final result or a queue/verifying task ID. Read that existing ID with bounceban_single_status later. Never resubmit s

tools.name: bounceban_single_status
tools.description: Read an existing single verification ID without spending verification credits. Returns success, verifying or queue. Honor try_again_at when provided; poll no more than 10 times for an ID within 5 minutes, then stop. Results remain available for 90 days. This tool never starts another verification.

tools.name: bounceban_create_bulk_verification
tools.description: Submit 1–1,000 emails for regular-mode asynchronous verification. Starts a task and can consume verification credits; requires confirm:true. Check the dashboard before resubmitting after a lost/invalid response. greylisting_bypass:auto balances speed and accuracy; speed may yield more risky results;

tools.name: bounceban_bulk_status
tools.description: Read progress and aggregate results of an existing bulk task. Does not start verification. Wait between polls and honor account rate limits. importing/verifying status is still pending; finished means the task has ended.

tools.name: bounceban_bulk_results
tools.description: Read up to 100 existing email results and a cursor for the next page. Results are retained for 90 days. No verification is started and no following page is fetched automatically. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bounceban_verify_email, bounceban_create_bulk_verification, bounceban_bulk_results · Private data: bounceban_account · Public sink: bounceban_verify_email, bounceban_create_bulk_verification, bounceban_bulk_results.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bounceban_verify_email, bounceban_create_bulk_verification, bounceban_bulk_results · Private data: bounceban_account · Public sink: bounceban_verify_email, bounceban_create_bulk_verification, bounceban_bulk_results

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
